General Committee

This committee was formed at the 2nd sitting of the 20th People's Majlis, held on 3 June 2024. The responsibility of this committee is to review matters that need to be reviewed in relation to the procedures for conducting the business of the People's Majlis; to study any amendment, if one needs to be brought to the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis; to study members' salaries and allowances and other such matters not falling within the scope of responsibility of any committee; to advise the Speaker of the Majlis on matters concerning employees in the Parliamentary Service; and to study and bring changes that need to be made to the Parliamentary Service Regulations.

1. Introduction

This is the report of this committee's study and decision on the matter submitted by the Member for Thulhaadhoo constituency, Abdul Hannan Aboobakuru, to amend Article 191 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, in accordance with Article 272(c) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, following its referral to this committee for study at the 6th sitting of the third session of 2026 of the People's Majlis, held on 19 October 2026.

2. Amendment submitted to the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis

In studying the amendment submitted to Article 191 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, the committee decided to amend (b) and (c) of that amendment as follows.

| As submitted in the amendment | 191. | (b) | That it is not a resolution on a subject related to the debate that will take place on a resolution already submitted; |
| As proposed by the committee | 191. | (b) | That it is not a resolution on the subject of a resolution previously submitted to the Majlis and proceeding; |
| As submitted in the amendment | 191. | (c) | A resolution shall be put to a vote for acceptance before the preliminary debate on the resolution begins; if it is passed that the resolution be accepted, after the preliminary debate the resolution shall then proceed to a committee related to that resolution. If it is not passed that the resolution be accepted, that resolution shall be void. No further debate shall take place on that resolution. |
| As proposed by the committee | 191. | (c) | Putting to a vote, before the preliminary debate on the resolution begins, whether or not the resolution should be accepted. Accordingly, if it is passed that the resolution be accepted, after the preliminary debate the resolution shall then proceed to the committee related to that resolution. If it is not passed that the resolution be accepted, the resolution becoming void and no further debate being held on that resolution. |

[signature] [stamp]

3. Committee's decision

The committee studied the amendment submitted by the Member for Thulhaadhoo constituency, Abdul Hannan Aboobakuru, to Article 191 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, in accordance with Article 272(c) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, and, after deliberation among the committee members on that amendment, at the committee's 17th meeting of 2026, held on 20 October 2026, passed the amendment, with the amendments made to it by the committee, by consensus of the members present at the committee and taking part in the vote, and decided to submit it to the People's Majlis, requesting that the People's Majlis consider it as passed by the committee.

Accordingly, we submit this report to the People's Majlis under Article 116(a) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis so that the People's Majlis may consider and decide on Article 191 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis as amended and passed by the committee.

Article 191 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, as amended and passed by the committee, is included as "Schedule-1" of this report.

Also, details of members' attendance at the committee meeting held to study the matter submitted by the Member for Thulhaadhoo constituency, Abdul Hannan Aboobakuru, to amend Article 191 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis are included as "Schedule-2" of this report.

Schedule 1: Article 191 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, as amended and passed by the committee

[signature] [stamp]

Schedule-1

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Amendment to the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis

To bring the following amendment to the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis.

1. To amend Article 191 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis as follows.

| Difference between a resolution and a bill | 191. | | Any member of the Majlis may submit a resolution. Compared with a bill, a resolution has the following differences. That is: |
| | | (a) | That a resolution, unlike a bill, contains a preamble; |
| | | (b) | That it is not a resolution on the subject of a resolution previously submitted to the Majlis and proceeding; |
| | | (c) | Putting to a vote, before the preliminary debate on the resolution begins, whether or not the resolution should be accepted. Accordingly, if it is passed that the resolution be accepted, after the preliminary debate the resolution shall then proceed to the committee related to that resolution. If it is not passed that the resolution be accepted, the resolution becoming void and no further debate being held on that resolution. |
| | | (d) | That once the committee stage is completed and the resolution is passed by the Majlis, it need not be sent for ratification in the manner in which a bill is sent for ratification. |

2. This amendment shall come into force from the date on which the People's Majlis passes this amendment.
